ingredients.name: water, for soaking, plus more for cooking
red bell pepper, rinsed and finely chopped

steps.instruction: Rinse 1 pound of dried pink beans and pick out any rocks or debris.
steps.spoken: Rinse 1 pound of dried pink beans and pick out any rocks or debris. Rinse the beans and pick through them for rocks and other debris. Throw the debris away.

steps.instruction: Put the beans in a large pot and add 10 cups of water.
Place the pot in the refrigerator and let the beans soak overnight.
Put the beans in a large pot with water to cover them by about 1 inch.
Boil gently with the lid tilted for 1 hour, until the beans are soft.
steps.spoken: Boil gently with the lid tilted for about 1 hour, until the beans are soft. If the water drops below the top of the beans, add more water.

steps.instruction: Add 2 medium plantains and 1 large tomato, finely chopped.
Add 1 small red bell pepper and 1 medium white onion, finely chopped.
Add 1 1/2 tablespoons of minced garlic and 1 1/2 teaspoons of salt.
Cook on low heat until the plantains are soft.
